title: Wilson Sonsini, Wadia Ghandy review Atanu Chakraborty's resignation from HDFC Bank; find no evidence of claims
description: US-headquartered law firm Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati and Indian firm Wadia Ghandy & Co jointly reviewed the resignation of former HDFC Bank part-time Chairman Atanu Chakraborty over differences in "values and ethics", finding that his statement was inconsistent with evidence.The two firms were retained as external firms by HDFC Bank in March 2026 following Chakraborty's resignation.
